ORDER BY id');\n        $stmt->execute([$row['id']]);\n        $milestones = [];\n        $doneCount = 0;\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $m) {\n            $isDone = (int) $m['done'] === 1;\n            $milestones[] = [\n                'milestone' => $m['milestone'],\n                'done' => $isDone,\n            ];\n            if ($isDone) {\n                $doneCount++;\n            }\n        }\n        $total = count($milestones);\n        $status = $row['status'];\n        if ($total > 0 && $doneCount === $total) {\n            $status = 'completed';\n        }\n\n        return [\n            'id' => $row['id'],\n            'campaign_id' => $row['campaign_id'],\n            'title' => $row['title'],\n            'status' => $status,\n            'milestones_total' => $total,\n            'milestones_done' => $doneCount,\n            'milestones' => $milestones,\n        ];\n    }\n\n    public function updateQuestProgress(string $campaignId, string $questId, array $completed): ?array\n    {\n        $quest = $this->getQuest($questId);\n        if (!$quest || $quest['campaign_id'] !== $campaignId) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE quest_milestones SET done = 1 WHERE quest_id = ?
